row: Welcome to Beyond Your Massage Table! With over 30 years of experience as a licensed massage therapist and 16 years as a Massage Therapist Instructor, I'm sharing the knowledge, techniques, and real-world lessons I've learned throughout my career.  Whether you're looking for self-care tips, stress relief techniques, massage therapy continuing education, or just honest advice about the profession, you'll find practical information you can use in everyday life.  From common mistakes therapists make to simple ways to reduce tension in your personal life, or in the massage room, my goal is to help you feel better, move better, and live better.  Learn something new and/or share your experiences also.  Subscribe and join me as we explore wellness, healing, and the wisdom that comes from decades of hands-on experience.
